# WebSaurus Lotties: full details

Site: https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/
Mascot: WebSaurus, the W2 mascot. A red dinosaur in chunky nerd glasses and a warm graphite hoodie with a white W2 on the chest. He cannot reach the keyboard, but he never drops his yellow highlighter. He marks the signal.
Brand line: Tiny arms. Big takes.
Personality: the smartest friend at the party, explaining the future with a straight face and one excellent joke. Punches up at the tool, never down at the learner. Translates, does not perform.

## Colours
- Signal Red #D40016 (skin)
- Oxblood #6E0A12 (spots, tongue)
- Ink #171615 (outlines)
- Graphite #2B2826 (hoodie)
- Paper #F4F4F2 (glasses, teeth, claws)
- Yellow #FFD23F (highlighter, accent only)
- Cream #EFE5DC (MP4 and GIF background)

## Formats
- Lottie JSON: 512 by 512, 60fps, transparent background (the avatar has its own ink circle). Plays in lottie web 5.12, lottie iOS, lottie Android, Webflow and LottieFiles.
- .lottie: dotLottie v1 zip holding the same JSON. websaurus-all.lottie holds all eight, with idle as the active animation.
- MP4: 1080 by 1080, H.264, 60fps, cream background, looped to at least six seconds.
- GIF: 480 by 480, 30fps, cream background, loops forever.

## Animations
### Idle (4s)
Full body. Breathing, tail sway, a glance to the side, two blinks, a smug brow raise and a highlighter twirl. The default loop.
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-idle.json (28 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/dotlottie/websaurus-idle.lottie (2 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/mp4/websaurus-idle.mp4 (1236 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/gif/websaurus-idle.gif (1676 KB)

### Hype jump (2s)
Full body. Crouches, jumps, switches to the cackling face in the air, lands with a squash and raises a smug brow.
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-hype.json (36 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/dotlottie/websaurus-hype.lottie (3 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/mp4/websaurus-hype.mp4 (1489 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/gif/websaurus-hype.gif (1226 KB)

### Talk (2s)
Head only. The mouth opens and closes at an uneven speaking rhythm, with a tongue, a gentle head bob, a blink and a brow raise. Made for voiceover and explainer videos.
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-talk.json (20 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/dotlottie/websaurus-talk.lottie (2 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/mp4/websaurus-talk.mp4 (1070 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/gif/websaurus-talk.gif (1190 KB)

### Smug (3s)
Head only. The hot take face: eyebrow wiggle, a side eye toward the viewer, a slow head tilt and a blink.
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-smug.json (13 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/dotlottie/websaurus-smug.lottie (1 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/mp4/websaurus-smug.mp4 (915 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/gif/websaurus-smug.gif (1516 KB)

### Shocked (2s)
Head only. The wait, what? face: a jolt upward, raised brows, shrinking pupils, a popping mouth, burst lines above the head and a tremble.
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-shocked.json (14 KB)
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/dotlottie/websaurus-shocked.lottie (1 KB)

### Thinking (3s)
Head only. The upgrade face: eyes look up and drift, the head tilts and three thought dots pop in one after another.
- https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-thinking.json (13 KB)

### Cackling (2s)
Head only. The useful chaos face: eyes squeezed shut and a big open mouth with a bobbing, shaking laugh.

### Avatar (3s)
Head on an ink circle with a paper outline. The smug loop, for animated profile pictures on X and YouTube.
